Poss-SLPC sro Reports Stable Revenue Growth Amidst Steady Market Demand

Poss-SLPC sro, a leading player in Slovakia’s steel industry, has posted stable financial results for the latest quarter, reflecting resilient demand from automotive, construction, and engineering sectors. The Bratislava-based company reported revenues of €97.5 million for the first quarter of 2024, marking a 3.2% increase compared to €94.5 million in the corresponding period last year. EBITDA rose to €12.8 million, up from €12.1 million year-on-year, supported by cost efficiencies and robust order volumes.

Commenting on the results, Poss-SLPC sro CEO Martin Koller said, “We’ve seen continued strong engagement from our core customers in Slovakia and across Central Europe. Our team’s focus on quality and timely delivery has helped us sustain growth despite a competitive landscape. We remain committed to investing in our production facilities to meet evolving market needs.”

The company highlighted increased shipments of flat steel products, with a notable uptick in orders from domestic infrastructure projects. Shipments totaled 82,000 metric tons, up 2.5% year-on-year, according to the quarterly statement. Poss-SLPC sro also noted a marginal improvement in gross margins, attributed to energy-saving initiatives and digitalization of logistics operations.

Jozef Urban, an analyst at Slovak Metals Insight, noted, “Poss-SLPC sro’s results reflect a broader trend of stabilizing steel demand in Central Europe. While global steel price volatility continues, local infrastructure and automotive investments are providing a reliable pipeline for Slovak producers.”

The Slovak Association of Steelworkers welcomed the results, with spokesperson Lenka Timkova stating, “The steady performance of companies like Poss-SLPC sro is essential for maintaining employment and industrial activity in the region. Continued investment in skills and technology will be key to sustaining this momentum.”

Looking ahead, Poss-SLPC sro management signaled ongoing investment in process automation and sustainability, with plans to allocate €5 million to energy efficiency upgrades in 2024. The company’s board reaffirmed its guidance for moderate revenue growth through the remainder of the year, citing order backlogs and steady customer demand.

Poss-SLPC sro employs approximately 540 staff at its primary production site in western Slovakia and continues to be a significant contributor to the regional economy.
